payload.name: ToolMatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Describe a task or problem to find relevant ChatGPT apps from a curated catalog. Each result explains why it fits and highlights important limitations. ToolMatch links to app pages in ChatGPT, requires no login, and does not sell products or process payments.
payload.longDescription: 描述任务或问题，即可从精选目录中查找相关 ChatGPT 应用。每条结果都会说明应用适用的原因，并突出重要限制。ToolMatch 提供指向 ChatGPT 应用页面的链接，无需登录，也不会销售产品或处理付款。

payload.name: Symbol
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Symbol helps users save notes, decisions, docs, snippets, and other capsule content, then search, edit, reference, organize, and share that knowledge through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Symbol 帮助用户保存笔记、决策、文档、片段及其他 capsule 内容，然后通过 ChatGPT 搜索、编辑、引用、整理和分享这些知识。

payload.name: Customer Info Validator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Check whether customer or sales lead records contain all required information. The app identifies present and missing fields, supports custom field requirements, and treats valid values such as 0 and false correctly. It is read-only and does not score customers, predict sales outcomes, update CRM records, or perform external actions.
payload.longDescription: 检查客户或销售线索记录是否包含所有必填信息。该应用会识别已填写和缺失字段，支持自定义字段要求，并能正确处理 0 和 false 等有效值。它仅提供只读功能，不会给客户评分、预测销售结果、更新 CRM 记录或执行外部操作。

payload.name: StorageChain
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search and read files your organization has connected to StorageChain BYOC. Find permitted documents across supported cloud repositories, read supported content, and open source citations in StorageChain. Existing organization, connection, and folder permissions are applied to each request.
payload.longDescription: 搜索并阅读组织已连接到 StorageChain BYOC 的文件。在支持的云存储库中查找有权访问的文档、阅读支持的内容，并在 StorageChain 中打开来源引文。每项请求都会遵循组织、连接和文件夹现有的权限设置。

payload.name: HaitiDocs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HaitiDocs finds and returns sourced Haiti economic material from a curated public library: search across indicators, documents, World Bank projects, map layers, and news; open a full document or data series with its source attribution and citation; pull cited passages to ground and draft briefings and analytical notes; and retrieve map-layer GeoJSON for display or spatial analysis. Every result carries a source publisher, freshness, and citation, so the app acts as a finder and forwarder rather than the author of the underlying data.
payload.longDescription: HaitiDocs 从精选公共资料库中查找并返回带来源的海地经济资料：搜索指标、文件、世界银行项目、地图图层和新闻；打开带来源归属和引用的完整文件或数据序列；提取带引用的段落以支持简报和分析笔记；获取用于展示或空间分析的地图图层 GeoJSON。每个结果都附有发布者、新鲜度和引用，因此该应用是资料查找和转发工具，而不是底层数据的作者。

payload.name: Diverge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Your resume should never be out of date again. Diverge connects your AI assistant to your professional profile, so you update it, tailor it to any job, and download a polished PDF just by chatting. Keep multiple personas for different roles, and see how your shared resume performs. No forms, no copy-paste. Just tell your assistant, and it's done.
payload.longDescription: 你的简历再也不会过时。Diverge 将 AI 助手连接到你的职业档案，让你只需聊天即可更新档案、针对任意职位进行调整，并下载精美的 PDF。你可以为不同岗位保留多份个人档案，并查看已分享简历的表现。无需表单或复制粘贴，只要告诉助手，它就会帮你完成。

payload.name: CodeQR - Link and QR Analytics
payload.description: 可编辑、可追踪的二维码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CodeQR creates short links and QR codes that stay editable after they are printed or shared. Each code encodes a short link instead of the destination itself, so you can change where it leads without reprinting anything, and every scan and click is recorded with time, country, and device. It fits work where a code has to outlive the moment it was made: one code per property listing, per customer, per certificate, per job posting, or a printed campaign whose landing page moves. Your agent can create short links and QR codes on your own domain or a shared one, change where an existing code points, list codes it made earlier, and pull scan, click, lead, and sale analytics for one code or for the whole workspace.
payload.longDescription: CodeQR 创建的短链接和二维码在打印或分享后仍可编辑。每个码编码的是短链接，而非目标地址本身，因此无需重新打印即可更改跳转目标；每次扫描和点击都会记录时间、国家/地区和设备。适用于代码需要长期有效的场景：例如每个房源、客户、证书、招聘信息各使用一个码，或印刷活动中落地页可能变更的情况。你的智能体可以在自有域名或共享域名上创建短链接和二维码、更改现有二维码的指向、列出此前创建的码，并提取单个码或整个工作区的扫描、点击、潜在客户和销售分析数据。

payload.name: AirPrompter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: AirPrompter brings saved AirPrompter prompts and saved AirPrompter workflows into ChatGPT. Users can diagnose the connection, find and inspect saved content, review workflow steps, create and revise reusable prompts, and run workflows with ChatGPT carrying out each step. When a user asks to run, invoke, use, or continue a workflow or saved prompt, use AirPrompter even if they do not name it. AirPrompter also provides planning and draft-authoring guidance, remembers authoring preferences the user chooses to save, and supports authorized personal and team libraries. Saving or updating content is a separate action from reviewing or drafting it. A generic software workflow explanation, such as how GitHub Actions works, does not invoke AirPrompter unless the user asks to run one of their workflows.
payload.longDescription: AirPrompter将保存的AirPrompter提示和工作流带入ChatGPT。用户可以诊断连接状态、查找并检查保存内容、查看工作流步骤、创建和修改可重复使用的提示，并让ChatGPT执行每个步骤来运行工作流。当用户要求运行、调用、使用或继续工作流或保存的提示时，即使未提及AirPrompter也应使用该工具。AirPrompter还提供规划和初稿撰写指导，记住用户选择保存的撰写偏好，并支持授权的个人及团队库。保存或更新内容与审查或撰写内容是两个独立操作。除非用户明确要求运行其工作流，否则通用软件工作流说明（如GitHub Actions的工作原理）不会触发AirPrompter。

payload.name: Hoaster
payload.description: 将网页内容发布到 URL
payload.summaryOriginal: Publish web content to a URL
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn what you make in ChatGPT into a real, live web page, instantly. A landing page, a one-pager, an infographic, a chart, an image: Hoaster gives it a public link that's truly yours, even on your own domain. Just say "publish it," and it's online. No setup, no code, no strings.
payload.longDescription: 立即将你在 ChatGPT 中制作的内容变成真实上线的网页。无论是落地页、单页网站、信息图、图表还是图片，Hoaster 都会为你生成一个真正属于你的公开链接，也可以使用你自己的域名。只需说“发布”，内容就会上线。无需设置、无需代码，也没有附加条件。

payload.name: Tela
payload.description: 支持语义搜索的团队维基
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: tela is a markdown-native team wiki where AI agents are first-class participants. Connect ChatGPT to your team's knowledge base to read, write, and maintain docs at scale. • Semantic search ("research") — answer questions by meaning, returning assembled grounding from full page bodies with flagged source disagreements • Keyword search — ranked, snippet-highlighted full-text lookup • Authoring — create, update, and surgically patch pages; move, delete, share with public links • Knowledge health — surface near-duplicate pages, identify unanswered questions, suggest links • Atlas — auto-generate technical docs from git repos and Jira; trigger re-ingestion, poll coverage • Presentations — author, lint, and preview Slidev slide decks stored as wiki pages. Connect by signing in with your tela account. Self-host via docker compose (AGPL) or use telawiki.com.
payload.longDescription: tela 是一款以 Markdown 为核心的团队维基，AI 智能体是其中的一等参与者。连接 ChatGPT 与团队知识库，即可大规模读取、编写和维护文档。• 语义搜索（“research”）——按含义回答问题，从完整页面正文中整理依据，并标出来源之间的分歧 • 关键词搜索——按排名显示并突出摘要片段的全文搜索 • 内容编写——创建、更新并精细修改页面；移动、删除页面并通过公开链接分享 • 知识健康度——发现近似重复页面、找出尚无答案的问题并建议链接 • Atlas——根据 git 仓库和 Jira 自动生成技术文档；触发重新摄取并查询覆盖情况 • 演示文稿——编写、检查并预览以维基页面存储的 Slidev 幻灯片。使用 tela 账户登录即可连接。可通过 docker compose（AGPL）自行托管，也可使用 telawiki.com。

payload.name: Contextick
payload.description: 保存一次，在任何 AI 中随时调用
payload.summaryOriginal: Save once, recall in any AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Contextick is a personal knowledge layer for your AI. Save any text once —
a decision, an idea, a code snippet, research notes — and the AIs you connect
can bring it back later by meaning, right when it's relevant.

Because your knowledge lives in one private store instead of inside a single
assistant, it follows you across the tools you already use — ChatGPT, Claude,
and other MCP-compatible apps. Save something in one, recall it in another.

There's nothing to organize: no folders, no tags. You just save, and a short
bit of context surfaces the closest match when you ask. Use it to keep working
decisions, team conventions, preferences, and anything you'd rather not explain
to your AI twice.
payload.longDescription:
Contextick 是面向 AI 的个人知识层。只需保存一次任意文本——决策、想法、代码片段、研究笔记——你连接的 AI 就能在相关时刻按含义将其找回。

你的知识保存在一个私有存储库中，而非某个单独的助手里，因此可以随你在现有工具间流转——包括 ChatGPT、Claude 和其他兼容 MCP 的应用。在一个工具中保存，在另一个工具中找回。

无需整理：不用文件夹，也不用标签。只要保存，提问时就会呈现一小段最匹配的上下文。你可以用它记录工作决策、团队惯例、个人偏好，以及任何不想向 AI 重复解释的内容。

payload.name: MyAreaReport
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MyAreaReport helps users explore UK postcode, outcode, and place-based area intelligence inside ChatGPT. It retrieves official public data for crime, flood warnings, property prices, road traffic, and nearby fuel prices, then presents the results in a rich dashboard with deeper drill-down views.
payload.longDescription: MyAreaReport 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中探索英国邮编、邮区前缀和地区相关信息。它会检索犯罪、洪水预警、房价、道路交通和附近燃油价格等官方公开数据，并通过内容丰富的仪表板展示结果，还可进一步深入查看详情。

payload.name: TextExpander
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: TextExpander helps users search, read, create, update, move, and delete snippets and snippet groups from their TextExpander account, plus inspect profile, organization member, and usage statistics data when authorized.
payload.longDescription: TextExpander 可帮助用户在自己的 TextExpander 账户中搜索、读取、创建、更新、移动和删除文本片段及片段组；在获得授权时，还可查看个人资料、组织成员和使用统计数据。

payload.name: 1to1 Mate
payload.description: 为每次1对1会议提供AI上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・Available on all plans, including the free plan
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the full connection walkthrough and the exact fields each tool returns.
payload.longDescription:
1to1 Mate是一款以1对1会议为核心的关系管理应用。

这是一款为依赖持续1对1对话工作人群设计的「外部记忆」工具——包括销售人员、社区运营者、管理者、创业者、顾问，以及所有需要定期开展1对1会议的用户。

核心功能

・成员管理：结构化存储每个人的的目标、价值观、技能、推荐需求、背景信息和标签
・AI会议记录：对会议音频进行自动转录，生成AI总结和行动事项
・数据看板：按时间顺序展示你曾会面的人、会面时间和讨论内容
・资料导入：从名片或网页中提取成员信息
・推荐匹配：根据过往对话AI建议合适的介绍对象

注：以上为1to1 Mate应用本身的功能。
音频转录、新会议记录创建和成员注册均在1to1 Mate应用内完成。
MCP/ChatGPT集成仅提供对通过上述功能记录的数据的只读访问权限。

通过ChatGPT你能实现

连接1to1 Mate与ChatGPT后，你可以询问诸如：

・根据上次我们讨论的内容，为我与田中的1:1会议起草下一份议程。
・查找在营销方面遇到困难的成员。
・根据她的目标，我成员列表中谁适合向山田介绍？
・总结我在上个月所有1:1会议中承诺的行动事项。

AI仅以严格只读方式访问您的数据。
通过此连接不会对数据进行任何修改或删除。

权限与数据处理

・所有计划均可使用，包括免费计划
・通过OAuth 2.1与PKCE进行身份验证；使用您的谷歌账户登录
・原始联系人信息（电话号码、电子邮件地址、消息ID）永远不会暴露给AI。
甚至连渠道类型标签也不会返回——MCP层会直接省略所有与联系人相关的字段
・您可随时从账户设置中断开此集成

有关完整的连接指南以及各工具返回的具体字段，请参阅https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp。

payload.name: Priority Guardian
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Priority Guardian — Your priorities deserve more than good intentions.

Protected Time, Flexible Planning: Priorities don't fail because you stopped caring. They fail because everything else is loud and your most important work is quiet. Priority Guardian makes the quiet work visible — so you can protect it.

Built for people who do entrepreneurial work and juggle more than one thing at a time.

HOW IT WORKS:
Priority Guardian connects your priorities to your Google Calendar so you can see where your time is actually going and stay accountable to what matters. 

Two modes:
Deadline work — hours invested, pace against deadline, where effort is going
Ongoing commitments — weekly hour targets, streaks, monthly results check-in


1. Kick off with: "Set up my priorities in Priority Guardian."
2. Name your priorities and assign a keyword (P1, P2, P3) to tag your Google Calendar events
3. See your priorities dashboard anytime — current progress at a glance. → "Show me my priorities."
4. Get your first weekly report  → "Show me my weekly report."
5. Inspect and adjust weekly → "Let's dig into what helps me progress/ hinders my progress"
6. Discover patterns over time  → "How was I keeping up with my priorities over the last weeks and months?"

The AI guides setup, narrates your data, and asks the questions worth sitting with. You decide what to do with it.
