payload.name: Cleared Colorado Jobs
payload.description: 查找科罗拉多州需安全许可的职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cleared Colorado Jobs helps users find current direct-employer openings at named Colorado workplaces that require a Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI clearance. Users can browse with bounded workplace, employer, clearance, polygraph, and freshness filters; inspect a current job; discover available filters; or retrieve citeable public job sources. The plugin is anonymous and read-only, and it never applies, saves, publishes, or changes data.
payload.longDescription: Cleared Colorado Jobs 帮助用户查找科罗拉多州指定工作地点中当前由雇主直接发布、要求 Secret、Top Secret 或 TS/SCI 安全许可的职位。用户可以使用范围受限的工作地点、雇主、安全许可、测谎和时效筛选条件浏览；查看当前职位；了解可用筛选条件；或检索可引用的公开职位来源。该插件匿名且只读，不会代为申请、保存、发布或更改数据。

payload.name: AI App Readiness Checker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Review AI App identity, MCP tool contracts, and submission materials before formal submission. Get structured readiness findings and a final verdict under a fixed ruleset. This read-only plugin does not access external systems, deploy apps, submit reviews, or guarantee approval.
payload.longDescription: 在正式提交前审阅AI应用身份、MCP工具契约和提交材料。获取结构化的就绪情况发现，以及基于固定规则集的最终判定。此只读插件不会访问外部系统、部署应用、提交审核或保证获批。

payload.name: AI Attorney Pakistan
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AI Attorney helps users research Pakistani law through a read-only legal corpus.
It can find Pakistani judgments and precedents, retrieve the full details of a
known case by ID or law-report citation, and locate relevant provisions from
Pakistani Acts, Ordinances, codes, rules, regulations, and the Constitution.

For Pakistan-specific legal questions and fact patterns, the plugin can supply
case law, legislation, or both so ChatGPT can produce a source-grounded answer.
Case results include citations and links when available. Full case records may
also include the earlier authorities cited by a judgment and later judgments that
cite it. Citation history does not by itself establish that a case remains good
law.

The plugin is retrieval-only: it does not file cases, contact courts, create or
modify external records, or act on a user's behalf. It requires an existing AI
Attorney account and eligible entitlement. Retrieved material and generated
analysis should be independently verified and are not a substitute for advice
from a qualified legal professional.
payload.longDescription:
AI Attorney 帮助用户通过只读法律语料库研究巴基斯坦法律。
它可以查找巴基斯坦判决和判例，通过 ID 或法律判例汇编引证检索已知案件的完整详情，并从巴基斯坦的法案、法令、法典、规则、法规和宪法中查找相关条款。

对于涉及巴基斯坦的法律问题和事实情形，该插件可提供判例法、成文法或两者兼有的材料，帮助 ChatGPT 生成有来源依据的回答。
案件结果会在可用时包含引证和链接。完整案件记录还可能包含该判决引用的早期权威判例，以及引用该判决的后续判决。仅凭引用历史，不能认定某一判例仍具有有效法律权威。

该插件仅用于检索：不提起诉讼、不联系法院、不创建或修改外部记录，也不代表用户采取行动。需要现有 AI Attorney 账户及符合条件的使用权限。检索材料和生成的分析应自行核实，不能替代合格法律专业人士的建议。

payload.name: RFP Response Checker
payload.description: 检查 RFP 回复覆盖情况
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RFP Response Checker is a read-only service that extracts explicitly stated requirements from user-provided RFP text and checks whether a supplied response addresses each requirement. It returns evidence-linked results showing addressed, partially addressed, and not addressed items without inventing unstated requirements.
payload.longDescription: RFP Response Checker 是一项只读服务，可从用户提供的 RFP 文本中提取明确列出的要求，并检查所提供的回复是否回应了每项要求。它会返回附有证据链接的结果，显示已回应、部分回应和未回应的条目，不会凭空添加原文未说明的要求。

payload.name: Stable Baseline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Stable Baseline is an end-to-end, agent-managed workspace for documentation, diagramming, whiteboarding, planning, and a shared knowledge graph (your team's brain). From ChatGPT you can author and edit living documents in Markdown with 40+ types of embedded diagrams (flowcharts, BPMN, sequence, mind maps, Gantt, and more); generate pixel-perfect diagrams and whiteboards and get them back as PNG, JPEG, or SVG; design a whole whiteboard from a single prompt; generate infographics on the fly from plain language; plan work with phases, tasks, dependencies, and timelines; log risks and improvements; and build a self-learning Knowledge Graph that shares context across all of it. It works at any level, from an individual organising personal notes to an enterprise managing organisation-wide context, through 180+ tools across 19 categories spanning documents, diagrams, infographics, whiteboards, plans, tasks, improvements, knowledge graph, members, and teams.
payload.longDescription: Stable Baseline 是一个端到端、由智能体管理的工作空间，涵盖文档、制图、白板、规划以及共享知识图谱（团队的大脑）。通过 ChatGPT，你可以用 Markdown 编写和编辑持续更新的文档，其中嵌入 40+ 种图表类型（流程图、BPMN、时序图、思维导图、甘特图等）；生成像素级精准的图表和白板，并以 PNG、JPEG 或 SVG 格式取回；通过单条提示设计完整白板；用日常语言即时生成信息图；按阶段、任务、依赖关系和时间线规划工作；记录风险和改进事项；并构建可在这些内容之间共享上下文的自学习知识图谱。它既适用于整理个人笔记，也适用于管理全组织上下文的企业；提供 180+ 种工具，分属 19 个类别，涵盖文档、图表、信息图、白板、计划、任务、改进、知识图谱、成员和团队。

payload.name: dochost.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: dochost lets users publish Markdown or HTML from ChatGPT as hosted pages, get clean shareable links, inspect their account limits, list and review published pages, update page content, and delete pages they no longer want online.
payload.longDescription: dochost 可让用户通过 ChatGPT 发布托管的 Markdown 或 HTML 页面，获取简洁、可分享的链接，查看账户限额，列出并检查已发布页面，更新页面内容，并删除不再希望在线保留的页面。

payload.name: Raytheon Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
At Raytheon, every breakthrough begins with extraordinary talent driven to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Here, your work isn’t hypothetical, it has real-world impact. Join the teams developing advanced technologies that help connect and protect the world while making a difference where it matters most.

The Raytheon Careers ChatGPT app makes it easy to discover opportunities that align with your skills, interests, and career goals. Search by location, job title, discipline, or skill set across engineering, manufacturing, software, cybersecurity, systems, operations, supply chain, business, and more.

Whether you’re exploring your next opportunity or ready to take on a new challenge, you’ll find meaningful work, opportunities to grow and the chance to help shape what’s next in defense technology.

Your next opportunity starts here.
payload.longDescription:
该插件寻找下一份机会。以下功能和限制适用：

At Raytheon, every breakthrough begins with extraordinary talent driven to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Here, your work isn’t hypothetical, it has real-world impact. Join the teams developing advanced technologies that help connect and protect the world while making a difference where it matters most.

The Raytheon Careers ChatGPT app makes it easy to discover opportunities that align with your skills, interests, and career goals. Search by location, job title, discipline, or skill set across engineering, manufacturing, software, cybersecurity, systems, operations, supply chain, business, and more.

Whether you’re exploring your next opportunity or ready to take on a new challenge, you’ll find meaningful work, opportunities to grow and the chance to help shape what’s next in defense technology.
Your next opportunity starts here.

payload.name: Riido
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Riido helps users inspect workspaces and teams, manage components, backlogs, and meetings, and update meeting bodies, links, board entries, statuses, labels, members, priorities, and comments through authenticated Riido workflows.
payload.longDescription: Riido 帮助用户检查工作区和团队、管理组件、待办事项和会议，并通过经过身份验证的 Riido 工作流更新会议正文、链接、看板条目、状态、标签、成员、优先级和评论。

payload.name: Atlas AI Agent
payload.description: 简报、销售线索与帖子草稿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Atlas AI Agent brings your Atlas workspace into ChatGPT, with three assistants in one place.

Ask for a briefing and the executive assistant reads your connected mailbox and calendar to tell you what needs attention today, what decisions are pending, and what you're still waiting on. Ask about sales and you get live pipeline figures, your leads ranked by score across campaigns, and a personalised outreach email drafted for whichever lead you name. Ask about marketing and you get channel performance, everything in the content queue with its status, whatever is sitting in your approvals, and new post drafts on request.

Nothing is sent or published from ChatGPT. Outreach emails and social posts come back as drafts you approve inside Atlas, so the assistant can never speak to a customer on your behalf without you seeing it first.

Connecting is a normal sign-in, and permissions are granted per assistant: you can give ChatGPT your marketing without handing over your inbox, and disconnect any time from Atlas under Connected apps.
payload.longDescription:
Atlas AI Agent 将你的 Atlas 工作区带入 ChatGPT，在同一个地方提供三位助手。

请求简报时，行政助手会读取已连接的邮箱和日历，告诉你今天有哪些事项需要关注、哪些决策尚待处理，以及你仍在等待哪些事项。询问销售时，你会获得实时销售管道数据、按评分排列的各营销活动销售线索，并可为指定线索起草个性化联系邮件。询问营销时，你会获得渠道表现、内容队列中的全部项目及其状态、等待你审批的事项，并可按需获取新帖子草稿。

ChatGPT 不会发送或发布任何内容。联系邮件和社交帖子会以草稿形式返回，由你在 Atlas 内批准，因此助手绝不会在你事先查看前，代表你向客户发声。

连接采用常规登录方式，权限按助手分别授予：你可以让 ChatGPT 访问营销数据，而不交出收件箱；也可随时在 Atlas 的 Connected apps 中断开连接。

payload.name: CarVault
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CarVault connects ChatGPT to your CarVault account to list vehicles, review fuel and ownership costs, check upcoming reminders, and add fuel, expenses, service records, or odometer readings. Use CarVault whenever you ask about your cars, vehicle history, maintenance, or ownership records.
payload.longDescription: CarVault 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 CarVault 账户，用于列出车辆、查看燃油和持有成本、检查即将到来的提醒，以及添加加油记录、支出、保养记录或里程表读数。只要你询问汽车、车辆历史、维护或所有权记录，就可以使用 CarVault。

payload.name: Juridata
payload.description: 搜索摩洛哥法律和裁判
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Juridata brings Moroccan legal research directly into ChatGPT. Search thousands of court decisions (jurisprudence) and legal texts, then open the full document in seconds — no more digging through scattered databases.

Ask in plain language and Juridata surfaces the relevant rulings and statutes, with filters by court chamber, year, and legal category. Whether you're a lawyer building a case, a law student researching precedent, or a business checking your obligations, you get answers grounded in real Moroccan legal sources.

The first AI legal research assistant for Morocco and North Africa in ChatGPT — making the region's case law and legislation searchable, readable, and instantly accessible.
payload.longDescription:
Juridata 将摩洛哥法律研究带入 ChatGPT。搜索数千份法院裁判和法律

文本，并在几秒内打开完整文件。使用自然语言提问，按法院庭室、年份和法律类别筛选相

关裁判与法规。适合律师、法学生或需要核对义务的企业，内容基于真实摩洛哥法律来源。

payload.name: Traspion
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Traspion brings audio and video transcription workflows directly into ChatGPT. Connect your Traspion account to find recent files, read completed transcripts and translations, upload media for transcription, rename files, export content, and save approved transcript edits—all through natural conversation.

You can also check account usage and view custom vocabulary and spelling replacements. Traspion only accesses files associated with your connected account and keeps unsupported actions, such as deletion and billing changes, on the Traspion website.
payload.longDescription:
Traspion 将音频和视频转录流程直接带入 ChatGPT。连接 Traspion 账户后，你可以查找最近文件、阅读已完成的转录和翻译、上传媒体以进行转录、重命名文件、导出内容，并保存已批准的转录修改，全程通过自然对话完成。

你还可以查看账户用量，以及自定义词汇和拼写替换。Traspion 仅访问与你已连接账户关联的文件；删除和更改账单等不支持的操作仍需在 Traspion 网站上进行。

payload.name: Rize
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rize helps users inspect tracked time, app and website activity, projects, clients, tasks, team workloads, and profitability data. The MCP tools support listing and creating time entries, approving AI suggestions, adding work notes, managing clients/projects/tasks/team members, and reviewing contract profitability inside the user's authenticated Rize workspace.
payload.longDescription: Rize 帮助用户查看已追踪的时间、应用和网站活动、项目、客户、任务、团队工作量及盈利数据。MCP 工具支持列出和创建工时记录、批准 AI 建议、添加工作备注、管理客户/项目/任务/团队成员，并在用户已通过身份验证的 Rize 工作区中查看合同盈利情况。

payload.name: DailyHero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DailyHero helps parents use ChatGPT to understand family task progress, points, rewards, and recent activity, then create parent-managed tasks and rewards for their children. It can read DailyHero family data and create tasks or rewards when the parent grants create access. It cannot approve task completions, redeem rewards, change points directly, manage child profiles, or perform account and privacy actions.
payload.longDescription: DailyHero 帮助家长通过 ChatGPT 了解家庭任务进度、积分、奖励和近期活动，然后为孩子创建由家长管理的任务和奖励。家长授予创建权限后，它可以读取 DailyHero 家庭数据并创建任务或奖励。它不能批准任务完成、兑换奖励、直接更改积分、管理儿童档案，也不能执行账户和隐私相关操作。

payload.name: Form Field Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Form Field Extractor extracts field names and values from user-provided form text and returns a structured field result.

It is designed for forms such as registration forms, application forms, customer intake forms, feedback forms, onboarding forms, and similar business form text.

The app can identify form-like lines, extract field names and values, normalize field names when requested, identify empty fields, and provide a short extraction summary.

This app is read-only. It does not submit forms, modify forms, validate required fields, check whether a form is ready to submit, approve or reject applications, contact people, send emails, call phone numbers, update CRM systems, update databases, or perform any external system action.
payload.longDescription:
Form Field Extractor
从用户

提供的表单文本中提取字段名和值，识别空字段并可规

范化字段名，返回结构化结果。只读，不提交或修改表

单、不验证必填项、不联系任何人或执行外部系统操作。该功能为只读。

payload.name: HG Insights - RGI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HG Insights - Revenue Growth Intelligence gives sales teams instant access to comprehensive prospect data. 
Get technology stacks, company firmographics, decision-maker contacts, IT spending insights, and contract intelligence for any company. 
Simply ask about a company by name or domain to uncover actionable sales intelligence powered by HG Insights data. 
Requires a RGI Developers or RGI Agents account from HG Insights.
payload.longDescription:
HG Insights - Revenue Growth Intelligence 为销售团队即时提供全面的潜客数据。
查询任何公司的技术栈、公司基本信息、决策者联系人、IT 支出洞察和合同情报。
只需按公司名称或域名提问，即可获取由 HG Insights 数据支持、可用于行动的销售情报。
需要 HG Insights 的 RGI Developers 或 RGI Agents 账号。

payload.name: Trackunit IrisX
payload.description: 将车队数据转化为行动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Query your Trackunit fleet, identify faults and idle assets, create alerts and access keys, update asset data, and automate recurring reports. Requires an active Trackunit IrisX subscription.
payload.longDescription: 查询你的 Trackunit 车队，识别故障和闲置资产，创建提醒和访问密钥，更新资产数据，并自动生成定期报告。需要有效的 Trackunit IrisX 订阅。

payload.name: Squish
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Squish turns a public video URL into timestamped contact sheets that ChatGPT can read. Users can review what happens across a clip, cite visual moments by timecode, and repeatedly zoom into a start and end range to resolve finer moments.
payload.longDescription: Squish 将公开视频 URL 转换为带时间戳的联系表，供 ChatGPT 阅读。用户可以查看片段中发生的内容，按时间码引用视觉片段，并反复放大起止范围，以辨清更细节的画面。

payload.name: Edito-Pdf
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Edito-Pdf lets you search, read, and analyze documents that have been pseudonymized or anonymized by the Omissis system. Using ChatGPT, you can locate files across your personal drive and shared drives, extract their text, and generate professional reports or summaries. When a document needs to be sent with real data restored, Omissis performs de-pseudonymization automatically and delivers the result to your email — without ever exposing sensitive information in the conversation.
payload.longDescription: Edito-Pdf 可让你搜索、阅读和分析由 Omissis 系统进行假名化或匿名化处理的文档。借助 ChatGPT，你可以在个人云盘和共享云盘中查找文件、提取文本，并生成专业报告或摘要。如果需要恢复真实数据后再发送文档，Omissis 会自动执行去假名化，并将结果发送到你的邮箱，全程不会在对话中暴露敏感信息。

payload.name: OnceHub
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: OnceHub lets authenticated users manage their own meetings, booking calendars and hubs, booking links, and recurring or date-specific availability through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: OnceHub 允许通过 ChatGPT 管理已通过身份验证的用户自己的会议、预订日历和中心、预订链接，以及定期或指定日期的可用时段。

payload.name: Timezone Buddy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Timezone Buddy helps people work across time zones. It can look up the current time for an IANA time zone, convert a specific date and time across multiple time zones with daylight saving time handled automatically, and find overlapping meeting windows for distributed teams.
payload.longDescription: Timezone Buddy 帮助人们跨时区协作。它可以查询 IANA 时区的当前时间，自动处理夏令时并转换多个时区之间的特定日期和时间，还可以为分布式团队寻找重叠的会议时段。

payload.name: VoiceCursor Dictionary
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: View and safely manage manual words and text replacements in your VoiceCursor dictionaries for macOS, iOS, and Android, with explicit confirmation before changes.
payload.longDescription: 查看并安全管理 VoiceCursor 词典中的手动添加词条和文本替换，适用于 macOS、iOS 和 Android。执行更改前会明确征求确认。

payload.name: Linko
payload.description: 轻松保存与回顾所学知识
payload.summaryOriginal: Save and recall what you learn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Linko lets users access and update their Linko knowledge workspace from ChatGPT. Users can fetch notes, create or edit notes, list subjects, find resources, and add links or books to their private Linko library after OAuth account linking.
payload.longDescription: Linko允许用户通过ChatGPT访问并更新自己的Linko知识工作区。用户可获取笔记、创建或编辑笔记、列出主题、查找资源，并在完成OAuth账户链接后，将链接或书籍添加至私人Linko图书馆。

payload.name: CloudMindMaps
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CloudMindMaps turns anything you're discussing in ChatGPT into a clear, interactive mind map. Ask it to map meeting notes, a report, a reading list, a project plan, or just a topic — CloudMindMaps structures the ideas and returns a live map with an inline preview, right in the chat.

Every map opens at cloudmindmaps.app as a free, browser-based, editable and shareable diagram, and uses the open FreeMind/Freeplane .mm format, so it also opens in those desktop apps.

What you can do:
• "Turn these notes into a mind map"
• "Make a mind map of the pros and cons of X"
• "List my mind maps and open the roadmap one"

Sign in once with your CloudMindMaps account; maps you create are saved there.
payload.longDescription:
CloudMindMaps 可以将你在 ChatGPT 中讨论的任何内容转化为清晰、交互式的思维导图。让它绘制会议笔记、报告、阅读清单、项目计划或某个主题的导图，CloudMindMaps 会梳理这些想法，并在聊天中直接返回带有内嵌预览的实时导图。

每张导图都会在 cloudmindmaps.app 上以免费、基于浏览器、可编辑和可分享的图表形式打开，并采用开放的 FreeMind/Freeplane .mm 格式，因此也可以在这些桌面应用中打开。

你可以这样使用：
• “把这些笔记整理成思维导图”
• “为 X 的优缺点制作思维导图”
• “列出我的思维导图，并打开路线图那张”

使用 CloudMindMaps 账户登录一次；你创建的导图会保存在账户中。

payload.name: Composio
payload.description: 在连接的应用程序之间协作
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Composio coordinates multi-step work across the user's authorized services. It discovers the tools needed for a request, retrieves their input requirements, runs dependent steps across apps, and combines the results into one response.
payload.longDescription: Composio可在用户授权的服务间协调多步骤操作，发现请求所需的工具，获取其输入需求，在多个应用中执行依赖步骤，并将结果整合为一个响应。

payload.name: Temponia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Temponia is a time-tracking and timesheet app for freelancers, agencies, and in-house teams who want their hours logged without it feeling like a chore.

Instead of a long list of empty fields, Temponia gives you a calendar view: drag to log hours the way you'd block out a meeting. Connect Google Calendar or Outlook and turn existing events into billable entries in a click. Native iOS and Android apps keep your week up to date when you're away from your desk.

What you can do with it:
  - Log time on a calendar, list, or timer, whichever fits the moment
  - Track tasks and projects with groupable dashboards by week, month, or year
  - Manage expenses alongside hours in one place
  - Sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO; provision teams via SCIM/JIT
  - Export clean timesheets and reports for clients or payroll
  
Good for solo consultants tracking billable hours, agencies invoicing clients, and teams that need a tidy record of where the week went.
payload.longDescription:
Temponia 是一款工时跟踪和工时表应用，适用于自由职业者、代理机构和内部团队，帮助他们轻松记录工时。

Temponia 不会让你面对一长串空白字段，而是提供日历视图：像安排会议一样拖动即可记录工时。连接 Google Calendar 或 Outlook，只需单击一下即可将现有日程转换为可计费工时记录。原生 iOS 和 Android 应用可让你离开办公桌时也能及时更新本周记录。

你可以使用它：
  - 通过日历、列表或计时器记录时间，选择最适合当前情境的方式
  - 跟踪任务和项目，并按周、月或年查看可分组的仪表板
  - 在同一处管理费用和工时
  - 使用 Google 或 Microsoft SSO 登录；通过 SCIM/JIT 为团队开通账户
  - 导出整洁的工时表和报告，供客户或薪资结算使用

适合跟踪可计费工时的独立顾问、向客户开票的代理机构，以及需要清楚记录一周时间去向的团队。

payload.name: Userflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Userflow account to the official Userflow MCP to query product adoption data and build directly in ChatGPT. Ask about flows, segments, users, and analytics (completion rates, NPS, survey responses, and event data) to see how users move through your product and find where they get stuck—then have ChatGPT create the segment, flow, chart, or dashboard the answer points to. Every write comes back as a draft you review; nothing publishes without you, all without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将你的 Userflow 账户连接到官方 Userflow MCP，即可在 ChatGPT 中查询产品采用数据并直接创建内容。你可以询问流程、细分群体、用户和分析数据（完成率、NPS、调查回复和事件数据），了解用户如何使用你的产品、在哪些环节遇到困难；然后让 ChatGPT 根据答案创建相应的细分群体、流程、图表或仪表板。每项写入操作都会以草稿形式返回供你审核；未经你确认，任何内容都不会发布。所有操作均可在 ChatGPT 中完成。

payload.name: KinicMemory
payload.description: 所有已保存信息一处查看
payload.summaryOriginal: All saved info in one place
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kinic is an AI memory for viewing information in one place.
It brings together bookmarks, emails, notes, and more into a single, organized view.
You can also explore useful, curated content shared by others.
Currently read-only, it makes information easy to browse and access.
payload.longDescription:
Kinic 是一个 AI 记忆工具，让你能够集中查看各类信息。
它将书签、电子邮件、笔记等内容整合到一个有序视图中。
你还可以探索其他人分享的实用精选内容。
目前仅支持只读，让信息浏览和访问更加便捷。

payload.name: CarMax Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CarMax Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at CarMax Careers. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: CarMax Careers 帮助求职者探索 CarMax Careers 的开放职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索——助手会呈现相关机会，并让你在申请前深入了解详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: ShareWatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ShareWatch gives ChatGPT scoped, audited access to Google Workspace files. Users can find, read, create, format, update, organize, preview, convert, and protect Google Docs, Sheets, Slides, folders, and uploaded files while ShareWatch enforces per-file access controls.
payload.longDescription: ShareWatch 为 ChatGPT 提供范围受限且经过审计的 Google Workspace 文件访问权限。用户可以查找、读取、创建、设置格式、更新、整理、预览、转换和保护 Google Docs、Sheets、Slides、文件夹及上传的文件；ShareWatch 会对每个文件实施访问控制。

payload.name: PDF4me
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PDF4me delivers an intelligent and efficient solution for all your PDFs.
Boost your productivity with PDF4me: access crucial data, make edits, and convert files to PDFs directly —all in ChatGPT. From single-document conversion to mega data files, PDF4me is there.
payload.longDescription:
PDF4me 为您所有的 PDF 提供智能、高效的解决方案。
使用 PDF4me 提升效率：直接在 ChatGPT 中提取关键数据、编辑内容并将文件转换为 PDF。从单个文档转换到海量数据文件，PDF4me 都能帮上忙。

payload.name: RescueTime
payload.description: 追踪时间并掌控专注状态
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RescueTime helps users understand their tracked activity, review project-time history, compare time across personal categories and productivity levels, inspect current focus state, and explicitly start or stop focus sessions and timers.
payload.longDescription: RescueTime 帮助用户了解已追踪的活动、查看项目时间历史、比较个人类别和效率等级的时间分配、检查当前专注状态，并主动开始或停止专注时段和计时器。

payload.name: Userbrain
payload.description: 访问你的用户测试数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore your user test data, summarize feedback, and uncover actionable insights faster. Ask questions about tests, participants, tasks, and findings in plain language.
payload.longDescription: 探索用户测试数据、汇总反馈，并更快发现可采取行动的见解。用日常语言询问测试、参与者、任务和发现。

payload.name: Fraghab
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Fraghab is a fragrance collection manager. It tracks the bottles and decants you own, how much is left in each, what you wore and when, and what you are saving up for.

Connect it and you can work with your own shelf in plain language. Ask what you have not worn since spring and it reads your collection. Say you wore the Santal 33 decant today, four sprays, and it logs the wearing and deducts the millilitres. Add a bottle you just bought in a sentence instead of a form, correct a rating or a note on one you already have, group bottles onto shelves, and save the layering combos you actually wear.

It also prices your wishlist. Ask for the best price on something you are saving for and Fraghab searches fragrance retailers for the cheapest current offer, tells you which shop has it, and gives the entry a product photo.

You authorize the connection on a Fraghab screen and approve each permission. Nothing can be deleted through it. Editing replaces what was there, so ChatGPT asks before it changes something you already had. Changing your Fraghab password revokes access immediately. Fraghab is free and takes no payment of any kind.
payload.longDescription:
Fraghab 是香水收藏管理器，跟踪您拥有的香水瓶和分装、每瓶余量、使用时间及愿望清单。连接后可用自然语言管理自己的香水架：查询春季以来未使用的香水，记录今天使用

Santal 33 分装四喷并自动扣除毫升数，用一句话添加新购买的香水，修改已有评分或备注，将香水分组到货架，并保存常用叠喷组合。它还会为愿望清单估价：搜索当前最低价、告诉您哪家店有货并提供产品照片。您在

Fraghab 页面授权连接并逐项批准权限。通过此连接不能删除任何内容；编辑会替换原有内容，因此

ChatGPT 在修改已有数据前会先询问。更改 Fraghab 密码会立即撤销访问。Fraghab 免费，完全不收取任何形式的付款。

payload.name: CoDiscover
payload.description: 发现负责任的 AI 使用场景
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CoDiscover helps people turn real work challenges into practical Human-AI use cases. It finds, compares, and sharpens opportunities across productivity, impact, inclusion, and innovation, then proposes a minimum test with explicit human accountability, trade-offs, non-AI alternatives, and Go/Revise/Stop criteria.
payload.longDescription: CoDiscover 帮助人们将真实工作挑战转化为切实可行的人机协作场景。它从生产力、影响力、包容性和创新等角度发现、比较并完善机会，随后提出一项最小化测试方案，明确人类责任、权衡因素、非 AI 替代方案以及继续/修订/停止标准。

payload.name: memorystore.in
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: MemoryStore is an AI-powered vault that transforms your short video library into a fully searchable second brain. Directly within ChatGPT, you can find those videos, remember something, and instantly retrieve exact transcript excerpts or targeted summaries from your personal library. By bridging the gap between “saved for later” and “find today,” the integration ensures every piece of content you accumulate is actively indexed, semantically searchable, and immediately accessible to power your daily workflows.
payload.longDescription: MemoryStore 是一款 AI 驱动的资料库，可将你的短视频库变成完全可搜索的第二大脑。你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中查找这些视频、回忆相关内容，并立即从个人资料库中检索准确的转录摘录或有针对性的摘要。该集成弥合了“稍后再看”和“现在就找”的间隙，确保你积累的每项内容都得到持续索引、语义搜索，并能随时用于日常工作流。

payload.name: StarryKit
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring an AI-powered visual design workflow into ChatGPT and Codex. Create, refine, review, and export polished, editable designs through natural conversation.

What you can create: AI presentations and pitch decks, posters and flyers, social media graphics, infographics, diagrams, cards, email designs, web concepts, UI mockups, and visual documents.

Create presentations: Turn a topic, outline, brief, or existing content into a polished, editable presentation. Create posters: Design event posters, promotional graphics, flyers, and visual art in any supported format. Create social media content: Produce editable designs for Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other channels. Create infographics and diagrams: Transform complex ideas, processes, and data into clear visual stories.

Recreate designs: Provide an image, screenshot, website, document, or design.md file as a visual reference. StarryKit analyzes its composition, typography, colors, hierarchy, and visual language, then recreates the direction with editable elements—without requiring a template.

Edit and refine: Rewrite complete pages or request focused changes to text, layout, colors, imagery, hierarchy, and formatting while preserving the rest of the design. Review generated page drafts in StarryKit before accepting them into your document.

Export designs: Download your finished work as PowerPoint, PDF, SVG, PNG, JPEG, or HTML, or export an editable presentation to Google Slides.

Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke StarryKit directly with @StarryKit.

Try prompts like:
- @StarryKit, create a 10-slide investor pitch deck for a sustainable urban farming startup.
- @StarryKit, design a bold poster for an electronic music festival in Tokyo.
- @StarryKit, turn this report into a clear, visual infographic.
- @StarryKit, recreate this website screenshot as an editable visual design.
- @StarryKit, make the headline larger, highlight the key metric, and preserve everything else.
- @StarryKit, export this presentation to PowerPoint and Google Slides.
payload.longDescription:
将 AI 驱动的视觉设计工作流带入 ChatGPT 和 Codex。通过自然对话创建、完善、审核并导出精致且可编辑的设计。

可创建内容：AI 演示文稿和路演材料、海报和传单、社交媒体图片、信息图、图表、卡片、电子邮件设计、网页概念、UI 模型和视觉文档。

创建演示文稿：将主题、大纲、简报或现有内容转换为精致且可编辑的演示文稿。创建海报：以任何支持的格式设计活动海报、宣传图、传单和视觉艺术。创建社交媒体内容：为 Instagram、LinkedIn、Facebook 和其他渠道制作可编辑设计。创建信息图和图表：将复杂想法、流程和数据转化为清晰的视觉叙事。

重现设计：提供图片、屏幕截图、网站、文档或 design.md 文件作为视觉参考。StarryKit 会分析其构图、字体、颜色、层级和视觉语言，然后用可编辑元素重现相应风格，无需模板。

编辑和完善：重写完整页面，或针对文字、布局、颜色、图像、层级和格式提出具体修改，同时保留设计的其他部分。将生成的页面草稿纳入文档前，可先在 StarryKit 中审核。

导出设计：将完成的作品下载为 PowerPoint、PDF、SVG、PNG、JPEG 或 HTML，也可以将可编辑演示文稿导出到 Google Slides。

安装后，用通俗语言描述需求，或直接使用 @StarryKit 调用。

可以尝试以下提示：
- @StarryKit，制作一份关于可持续城市农业初创公司的 10 页投资者路演材料。
- @StarryKit，为东京电子音乐节设计一张醒目的海报。
- @StarryKit，将这份报告改成清晰直观的信息图。
- @StarryKit，将这张网站截图重现为可编辑的视觉设计。
- @StarryKit，放大标题，突出关键指标，并保留其他所有内容。
- @StarryKit，将这份演示文稿导出为 PowerPoint 和 Google Slides。

payload.name: KDAN PDF
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect KDAN PDF to ChatGPT to prepare PDFs before you send them out. Ask ChatGPT to compare versions, remove selected pages, redact sensitive details, compress large files, or set and update PDF passwords. It helps keep proposals, reports, contracts, and other important documents ready before you share them with clients or teammates.
payload.longDescription: 将 KDAN PDF 连接到 ChatGPT，在发送 PDF 前做好准备。你可以要求 ChatGPT 比较不同版本、移除指定页面、涂黑敏感信息、压缩大文件，或设置并更新 PDF 密码。它帮助你在与客户或团队成员分享提案、报告、合同和其他重要文件之前，先完成整理。

payload.name: Jotter
payload.description: 在 AI 对话间延续上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Jotter saves what matters from one AI conversation so you never have to re-explain yourself in the next. Say 'jot this' and Jotter privately saves a note, or a handoff summary of the whole conversation. In a new chat later, or in a different AI assistant, say 'load my latest jot' and pick up where you left off, with your decisions, preferences, and next steps intact. You can also search your jots by keyword, list them, or delete them, right from the chat. Nothing is saved unless you ask, nothing ever auto-deletes, and your jots are private to you.
payload.longDescription: Jotter 会保存一段 AI 对话中的重要内容，让你在下一次对话中不必重新解释。说“jot this”，Jotter 就会私密保存一条笔记或整段对话的交接摘要。之后在新聊天或其他 AI 助手中，说“load my latest jot”，即可从上次进度继续，保留你的决定、偏好和后续步骤。你也可以直接在聊天中按关键词搜索、列出或删除 jot。除非你提出要求，否则不会保存任何内容；内容永远不会自动删除，jot 仅对你本人私密可见。

payload.name: CoachPilot
payload.description: 在聊天中管理学员和训练
payload.summaryOriginal: Seus alunos e treinos no chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
O CoachPilot é o sistema de gestão de personal trainers — alunos, prescrição de treino, avaliações físicas, histórico de sessões, agenda e financeiro. Conectando sua conta, você consulta e ajusta a sua carteira sem sair da conversa: "quem não treina há mais de 10 dias?", "como está a evolução de agachamento da Marina?", "monta o treino B dela para esta semana respeitando a anamnese".

Você autoriza com a sua própria conta CoachPilot e escolhe conceder apenas leitura ou também escrita de treinos. A conexão alcança somente os seus alunos. Toda alteração de treino é registrada, notificada a você e pode ser desfeita por 7 dias. Quem prescreve continua sendo você — o assistente analisa, propõe e, quando você pede, aplica.
payload.longDescription:
CoachPilot 是个人教练管理系统，涵盖学员、训练处方、体能评估、训练记录、日程和财务。连接账户后，您可以在不离开对话的情况下查询和调整自己的学员名单：“谁超过 10 天没训练？”“Marina 的深蹲进步如何？”“根据 B 的问诊资料，为她安排本周训练。”

您使用自己的 CoachPilot 账户授权，并选择仅授予读取权限，或同时授予训练写入权限。连接只涉及您的学员。所有训练修改都会记录并通知您，且 7 天内可以撤销。处方者仍然是您——助手负责分析、提出方案，并在您要求时应用。

payload.name: Onplana
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Onplana connects ChatGPT to your project portfolio. Describe the work in a sentence and it builds the project for you: epics, tasks, estimates, dependencies and scheduled dates, in a single step. Search across projects, tasks, sprints, risks, comments, and wiki with hybrid BM25 + vector search. Read project state, update tasks, log time, surface portfolio-level insights, and generate status reports, all gated by your org's plan and role permissions, with every operation audited. Built for teams migrating from Microsoft Project Online ahead of its September 2026 retirement.
payload.longDescription: Onplana 将 ChatGPT 与你的项目组合连接起来。用一句话描述工作，它就能一步构建项目：包括史诗任务、任务、估算、依赖关系和计划日期。通过混合 BM25 + 向量搜索，搜索项目、任务、冲刺、风险、评论和 Wiki。读取项目状态、更新任务、记录工时、呈现项目组合层面的洞察并生成状态报告；所有操作都受组织套餐和角色权限控制，并会经过审计。专为在 Microsoft Project Online 于 September 2026 退役前进行迁移的团队打造。

payload.name: Docket
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Docket AI makes your sales knowledge your instant superpower. Sales reps get accurate, on-demand answers to product, competitive, technical, and customer questions—pulled directly from your unified Sales Knowledge Lake™. Guided by verified company intel, reps handle objections confidently, uncover prospect details, and craft personalised responses on the spot.
payload.longDescription: Docket AI 让你的销售知识成为随时可用的超能力。销售代表可以按需准确回答产品、竞争、技术和客户相关问题——答案直接来自统一的 Sales Knowledge Lake™。在经过核实的公司信息指引下，销售代表可以自信地应对异议、了解潜在客户详情，并即时撰写个性化回复。

payload.name: Cox Careers
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Cox Careers helps job seekers explore open roles at Cox. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: Cox Careers 帮助求职者浏览 Cox 的开放职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索，助手会列出相关机会，并让你在申请前进一步了解详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: CrowdHum
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CrowdHum lets presenters create live audience polls and read their results from chat. Create a poll in a new room, add more polls to an existing room code (one QR, many polls), fetch live or final vote tallies, list your sessions and polls, read an AI session recap, and invite a co-owner. Visualization modes include column drift, rising bubbles, word cloud, 2x2 grid, ranking, and Q&A. The live presenter show (reveal, pause, vote streaming) stays in the CrowdHum web app.
payload.longDescription: CrowdHum 让演讲者创建实时观众投票，并在聊天中查看结果。可在新房间创建投票、向现有房间代码添加更多投票（一个二维码对应多个投票）、获取实时或最终票数、列出场次和投票、阅读 AI 场次回顾，并邀请共同所有者。可视化模式包括列状漂移、上升气泡、词云、2x2 网格、排名和问答。实时演示环节（揭晓、暂停、投票直播）仍需在 CrowdHum 网页应用中进行。

payload.name: Timebook
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Timebook helps solo professionals and small teams track billable work, manage clients and projects, and keep time entries accurate from ChatGPT. The app can list clients and projects, start and stop timers, log past work, review recent entries, and update or delete entries that the connected assistant is allowed to modify.
payload.longDescription: Timebook 帮助独立专业人士和小型团队通过 ChatGPT 跟踪可计费工作、管理客户与项目，并确保工时记录准确。此应用可以列出客户和项目、启动和停止计时器、记录过去的工作、查看近期记录，以及更新或删除已连接助手获准修改的记录。

payload.name: Teleprompter.com
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Draft, revise, and organize the scripts you read on camera, without leaving the conversation. Connect your Teleprompter.com account and ChatGPT can write a script with you, then save it straight to your workspace, filed in the right folder and ready for your next take.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Create scripts with playback settings applied as they're written: font size, scroll speed, timed-speed mode, text alignment, and estimated duration
- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

Because ChatGPT can read what you've already written, you can work from your own back catalogue: ask for a tighter cut of last month's intro, a 30-second version of a product explainer, or a consistent sign-off across everything in one folder.

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

Differences from the Claude description, both deliberate:
payload.longDescription:
无需离开对话，即可起草、修改并整理你在镜头前朗读的脚本。连接 Teleprompter.com 账户后，ChatGPT 可以和你一起编写脚本，然后直接保存到工作区，归入正确文件夹，供下次拍摄使用。

ChatGPT 可以：

- 创建脚本，并在编写时应用播放设置：字体大小、滚动速度、定时速度模式、文本对齐方式和预计时长
- 直接修改现有脚本。更新只涉及你指定的字段，其余设置保持原样
- 阅读你的资料库：按最新优先列出脚本，获取任意脚本的完整文本，并查看每个文件夹中的内容
- 整理内容：创建文件夹、重命名文件夹，并在文件夹之间移动脚本或移回根目录

由于 ChatGPT 能读取你已经写好的内容，你可以基于自己的历史素材继续创作：例如精简上个月的开场白、制作 30 秒的产品介绍，或统一某个文件夹中所有内容的结束语。

你需要拥有 Teleprompter.com 账户；所有账户等级均可使用此集成。连接时采用 OAuth，因此无需复制或保存密钥。你可以选择授予哪些权限：读取和写入脚本与文件夹分别需要单独批准，因此只读访问也是有效选择。ChatGPT 只能看到你自己的个人工作区。

保存在这里的脚本与你的 Teleprompter 应用读取的是同一份脚本，因此在对话中起草的内容，下次打开应用时即可使用。

与 Claude 描述的差异均为有意安排：

payload.name: SavedIt
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SavedIt helps people recover and organize their saved internet from ChatGPT. It can count and search an owner-scoped library, inspect saved-item details, discover and query private collections, save links, update notes or tags, manage collection membership and sharing, and delete only specifically selected resources.
payload.longDescription: SavedIt 帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中找回并整理自己收藏的互联网内容。它可以统计和搜索归属于用户的资料库、查看已保存项目的详情、发现并查询私人收藏集、保存链接、更新备注或标签、管理收藏集成员和分享，并且只删除明确选定的资源。

payload.name: Memco Shared Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Teams (of humans and agents) share knowledge so that lessons learned by one are available to all. Agents are smart but they don't know your internal practices, IP, and legacy code. Shared memory fills-in those gaps, and is orders of magnitude more effective than RAG.

Each team's workspace is private and protected by role-based access controls. 

Create your account for free at https://memco.ai.

Available as an MCP, cross-compatible  with agents from all vendors.

Your memory space is private to your team, protected by enterprise-grade information security, and governed by policies.
payload.longDescription:
团队（由人类和智能体组成）可以共享知识，让一方积累的经验教训惠及所有人。智能体虽然聪明，却不了解你的内部实践、知识产权和遗留代码。共享记忆可以填补这些空白，其效果比 RAG 高出多个数量级。

每个团队的工作空间都是私有的，并由基于角色的访问控制保护。

在 https://memco.ai 免费创建账户。

以 MCP 形式提供，可与所有厂商的智能体跨平台兼容。

你的记忆空间仅对团队开放，受企业级信息安全保护，并由各项政策进行管理。

payload.name: GoLinks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoLinks helps teams find, access, and share workplace knowledge faster by turning long URLs into secure, human-readable go links.

With the GoLinks app for ChatGPT, employees can search their company’s GoLinks library, find important resources, and get details about go links without leaving ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to look up a go link, search by keyword, summarize what a link is for, review ownership and usage details, or create a new go link for quick access to a resource.

GoLinks makes it easier for teams to navigate the apps, documents, dashboards, and information they use every day. Instead of remembering long URLs or searching through multiple tools, employees can simply ask ChatGPT for the go link they need.

Go links created by your organization are only accessible based on your workspace permissions, helping keep company resources secure while making knowledge easier to discover.

Use GoLinks in ChatGPT to reduce context switching, improve productivity, and give your team a faster way to access trusted workplace resources.
payload.longDescription:
GoLinks 将冗长的 URL 转换为安全且易读的 go link，帮助团队更快查找、访问和分享工作知识。

使用 ChatGPT 的 GoLinks 应用，员工无需离开 ChatGPT 即可搜索公司的 GoLinks 资源库、查找重要资源并查看 go link 详情。你可以让 ChatGPT 查找 go link、按关键词搜索、概述链接用途、查看所有者和使用情况，或创建新的 go link，以便快速访问资源。

GoLinks 让团队更轻松地浏览日常使用的应用、文档、仪表板和信息。员工无需记住很长的 URL，也不必在多个工具中搜索，只需向 ChatGPT 查询所需的 go link。

组织创建的 go link 仅根据你的工作区权限开放访问，有助于保护公司资源安全，同时让知识更容易被发现。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 GoLinks，减少上下文切换、提升效率，让团队更快访问可信的工作资源。

payload.name: Pelaris
payload.description: 规划、追踪、调整并获得指导
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plan training programs, log workouts, check benchmarks, and get personalised coaching advice directly from ChatGPT. Pelaris generates science-based, periodized programs across strength, running, swimming, cycling, triathlon, and CrossFit, then adapts them based on your performance. 31 tools for complete training management.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中规划训练计划、记录锻炼、查看基准指标并获取个性化指导建议。Pelaris 可为力量训练、跑步、游泳、骑行、铁人三项和 CrossFit 生成基于科学依据的周期化计划，并根据您的表现进行调整。提供 31 种工具，全面管理训练。

payload.name: stierproducts
payload.description: 产品等级榜单，条条有据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: S-to-F tier lists for 208 product categories, built by consolidating independent research runs over expert reviews and owner reports. Every placement is cited, and every citation carries the outlet, a verbatim quote, who said it, and whether we fetched the link and confirmed it. Boards are graded both ways: the products the research says to avoid are published in the bottom tiers rather than dropped, so you get the half a buying guide leaves out. Products carry GTIN barcodes and, where the maker published one, an announcement date. No affiliate links and no sponsored placements: no brand can pay to move on a board.
payload.longDescription: 针对 208 个产品类别制作 S 至 F 等级榜单，汇总多轮独立研究结果，依据专家评测和产品所有者报告进行整理。每项排名都有引用来源，每条引用都注明媒体、原文引述、发言者，以及我们是否已访问并确认链接。榜单既会标出值得推荐的产品，也会把研究建议避开的产品列入末档，不会将它们略去，因此你能看到普通购物指南常常缺少的另一半信息。产品还附有 GTIN 条码；若制造商公布了公告日期，也会一并列出。没有联盟链接，也没有赞助排名：任何品牌都不能付费改变榜单位置。

payload.name: Contract Information Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Contract Information Extractor helps ChatGPT organize information explicitly stated in user-supplied contract text. It extracts contract metadata, existing clauses, party obligations, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies into structured results. It does not assess legality, validity, fairness, enforceability, or legal risk, and it does not provide legal advice or recommend contract changes.
payload.longDescription: Contract Information Extractor 可帮助 ChatGPT 整理用户提供的合同文本中明确写明的信息。它会提取合同元数据、现有条款、各方义务、交付物、截止日期和依赖关系，并生成结构化结果。它不会评估合法性、效力、公平性、可执行性或法律风险，也不提供法律建议或建议修改合同。

payload.name: Bitmovin
payload.description: 通过 API 工具调用 Bitmovin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to a single Bitmovin MCP Server covering every product. Analyze Observability data, get insights on your ad performance, stream video with Player, manage Encoding jobs, run Stream Lab tests, and much more — all using natural language. With MCP Apps, visualize QoE and ad metrics through interactive charts and stream DASH or HLS playback directly in the chat.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到一个覆盖所有产品的 Bitmovin MCP Server。用自然语言分析 Observability 数据、了解广告表现、通过 Player 播放视频流、管理 Encoding 任务、运行 Stream Lab 测试，以及更多操作。借助 MCP Apps，通过互动图表可视化 QoE 和广告指标，并直接在聊天中播放 DASH 或 HLS 视频流。

payload.name: fairw.ai
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中查看会议
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Fairwai is a meeting intelligence platform that transcribes and analyzes your calls, video meetings, and in-person conversations. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to your meeting data: search past meetings semantically or by keyword, fetch the AI-generated report of any meeting (decisions, key points, action items), read raw transcripts, and list upcoming calendar events — all scoped to the meetings you have attended or been granted team access to.
payload.longDescription: Fairwai 是一个会议智能平台，可转录并分析电话、视频会议和面对面交流。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供只读会议数据访问：按语义或关键词搜索过往会议，获取任意会议的 AI 生成报告（决策、要点、行动项），阅读原始转录稿，并列出即将举行的日历活动；范围仅限于你参加过或获团队授权访问的会议。

payload.name: Menti
payload.description: 制作 Mentimeter 演示文稿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create interactive presentations for free with Menti. Whether you’re presenting online or in-person, Menti helps you engage your audience using real-time polls, live quizzes, Q&As and word clouds.

Ask participants to join your Menti from their phone or laptop, and they can answer questions and share insights together in the moment.

Turn an idea for your next meeting into a Menti in seconds. Suitable for all types of live speaking, from town halls and presentations to workshops, lectures and classes. Simply describe what you want to ask your audience, and Menti will build the perfect slide. Edit and reorder as much as you like, then decide whether to make the answers public so everyone can see, or keep them private to reduce bias. Time to turn your presentations into conversations with Menti by Mentimeter!
payload.longDescription:
使用 Menti 免费创建互动演示文稿。无论线上还是线下演讲，Menti 都能通过实时投票、现场问答测验、问答环节和词云帮助你调动观众。

参与者可以用手机或笔记本电脑加入你的 Menti，实时回答问题并共同分享见解。

只需几秒钟，就能把下次会议的想法变成一个 Menti。它适用于各种现场演讲场景，从全员大会和演示到研讨会、讲座和课堂。只要描述你想向观众提出的问题，Menti 就会制作出合适的幻灯片。你可以随意编辑和调整顺序，然后决定是否公开答案供所有人查看，或将其设为私密以减少偏见。使用 Mentimeter 的 Menti，把演示变成对话吧！

payload.name: Plugin Creator
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Turn your ideas, instructions, and everyday tasks into plugins. Describe what you want your plugin to do, and Plugin Creator helps you build it. Improve an existing plugin by refining its instructions, adding skills, or changing how it works.
payload.longDescription: 将您的想法、指令和日常任务转化为插件。描述您希望插件实现的功能，Plugin Creator 就会帮助您构建。您可以通过优化指令、添加技能或更改工作方式来改进现有插件。

payload.name: CiteLaw
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A complete legal research and firm-management toolkit inside ChatGPT.

Connect ChatGPT to CiteLaw’s U.S. legal database of millions of court opinions, statutes, regulations, court rules, standing orders, agency materials, and other legal authorities. ChatGPT retrieves CiteLaw’s source text instead of relying solely on model memory, producing answers grounded in identifiable authorities with direct citation links.

Legal research:
Ask legal questions in plain English and search cases, statutes, regulations, and rules across jurisdictions. Run Boolean, exact-phrase, metadata, and keyword searches. Retrieve an authority’s text and metadata, investigate how later courts have treated a case, and review a judge’s standing orders and practices. Paste a brief or citation list to verify authorities and identify possible, missing, or mismatched citations. Search documents and revisit prior research stored in your CiteLaw matters.

Firm management:
Review clients, contacts, tasks, deadlines, notes, documents, discovery, clauses, matters, saved workflows, team members, invitations, and workspace activity. Create and update leads, contacts, tasks, calendar events, discovery sets, clauses, matters, team workspaces, and reusable workflows. Run saved workflows in ChatGPT to follow your firm’s standardized research, review, and document processes. Use AI-assisted bulk imports to migrate contacts, matters, leads, tasks, deadlines, and notes from an existing case-management system in batches of 50, with source IDs that make reruns safe. Invite colleagues, manage workspace and matter access, assign roles, and set billing rates. Save notes and drafted Word documents to the active matter. Switch workspaces and matters so work remains in the correct team context.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains legal information; it does not provide legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中使用完整的法律研究和律所管理工具包。

将 ChatGPT 连接到 CiteLaw 的美国法律数据库，其中包含数百万份法院意见、法规、行政规章、法院规则、常规命令、机构材料及其他法律权威。ChatGPT 获取 CiteLaw 的来源文本，而非仅依赖模型记忆，生成基于可识别权威并带直接引用链接的答案。

法律研究：
用自然语言提出法律问题，并跨司法辖区搜索案例、法规和规则。运行布尔、精确短语、元数据和关键词搜索。获取权威文本及元数据，调查后续法院如何处理某案件，并查看法官的常规命令和办案惯例。粘贴法律文书或引用列表，核验权威来源并找出可能缺失或不匹配的引用。搜索文档并重新查看保存在 CiteLaw 案件中的过往研究。

律所管理：
查看客户、联系人、任务、截止日期、笔记、文档、证据开示、条款、案件、已保存工作流、团队成员、邀请和工作区活动。创建和更新潜客、联系人、任务、日历事件、证据集、条款、案件、团队工作区和可复用工作流。在 ChatGPT 中运行已保存工作流，执行律所标准化研究、审查和文档流程。使用 AI 辅助批量导入，从现有案件管理系统迁移联系人、案件、潜客、任务、截止日期和笔记，每批 50 条，并附源 ID 以便安全重跑。邀请同事、管理工作区和案件访问权限、分配角色及设置计费费率。将笔记和起草的 Word 文档保存到当前案件。切换工作区和案件，确保工作处于正确团队上下文。

面向律师、法学院学生和法律学者。CiteLaw 检索并解释法律信息，不提供法律建议，使用它不会建立律师—客户关系。

payload.name: Caipi
payload.description: 面向智能体的工作空间
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Caipi is a private workspace your AI assistant builds in. Notes, data, dashboards, full pages, even small web apps, your agent creates and updates them directly. You manage and use all of it from any device, not just read it.
payload.longDescription: Caipi 是一个由 AI 助手构建内容的私密工作空间。笔记、数据、仪表盘、完整页面，甚至小型 Web 应用，都可以由你的智能体直接创建和更新。你可以在任何设备上管理和使用这些内容，而不只是阅读。

payload.name: Buildory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buildory helps makers review progress, search structured project knowledge, prepare focused execution handoffs, maintain tasks and project structure, and manage linked resources and versioned artifacts. Read access is scoped to explicitly enabled projects; Pro and Creator users can separately authorize controlled updates. Permanent deletion, project publication and membership changes are unavailable.
payload.longDescription: Buildory 帮助创客查看进展、搜索结构化项目知识、准备重点明确的执行交接、维护任务和项目结构，并管理关联资源和带版本的成品。读取权限仅限明确启用的项目；Pro 和 Creator 用户可分别授权受控更新。无法进行永久删除、发布项目或更改成员关系。

payload.name: Algolia Productivity
payload.description: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Algolia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Algolia account to unlock supercharged automations on your workflows. Algolia Productivity lets users search and fetch records, explore indices, inspect their settings and analytics through ChatGPT using user-scoped OAuth access.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Algolia 账户，为工作流程启用更强大的自动化。Algolia Productivity 让用户通过限定于自身权限的 OAuth 访问，在 ChatGPT 中搜索和获取记录、探索索引，以及查看索引设置和分析数据。

payload.name: Clipform
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clipform builds interactive, mobile-first forms, quizzes, and surveys powered by video - all from chat. Create a form, add question and content steps, generate AI voiceover and video, attach your own images or clips, and get a live, shareable link - then read back the structure of what you built.
payload.longDescription: Clipform 可直接通过聊天创建由视频驱动、以移动设备为先的交互式表单、测验和调查。创建表单、添加问题和内容步骤、生成 AI 配音和视频、附加自己的图片或视频片段，并获取实时可分享链接；之后还可以查看已构建内容的结构。

payload.name: Atlas Red Mind Map
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Atlas Red is a workspace for structured mind maps. A map is a tree of topics, and every topic in a map shares the same author-defined fields — plain text, or typed ones like a select with its own options, a number or a date — so a map behaves like a small database you can see.

Connect your account and you can create maps, read a single topic's neighbourhood without pulling in the whole map, add and reorganise topics, fill in typed fields, link topics across branches, and import or export maps as Markdown, OPML, YAML and other formats. Every change is saved to your account, and anything you do here can be undone — from this conversation or later in the app.

The maps persist and stay yours: the same map opens in the Atlas Red web app on any device, on a visual canvas where you can rearrange it, colour it by one of its fields, attach images and share a read-only link.
payload.longDescription:
Atlas Red 是用于结构化思维导图的工作空间。
地图由主题树构成，地图中每个主题都共享相同作者定义的字段——可以是纯文本，也可以是下拉选择框（带独立选项）、数字或日期等类型字段，因此地图就像一个可视化的小型数据库。

连接您的账户后，可以创建地图、在不加载整张地图的情况下查看单个主题的周边内容、添加和重新整理主题、填写类型化字段、跨分支链接主题，并将地图导出或导入为 Markdown、OPML、YAML 等格式。
每次操作变更都会保存到您的账户，此处的任何操作均可撤销——无论是当前会话期间还是后续在应用中。

地图会持久化保存并始终属于您：同一张地图可在 Atlas Red 网页应用中任意设备打开，在可视化画布中可自由重新排列、按字段着色、添加图片，并分享只读链接。

payload.name: Upfluence
payload.description: 发现创作者并开展营销活动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Discover the right creators and run your campaigns without navigating multiple platforms. Simply describe what you're looking for in plain language, and ChatGPT will return results powered by Upfluence's search engine.

For example:
"Give me english-speaking TikTok creators interested in sustainable fashion with 50K–200K followers."
"What does the audience demographic look like for this creator?"

Based on your request, you'll receive a curated list of creator profiles that match your criteria. Review key details, explore their profiles, and check recent posts to evaluate whether they're a strong fit for your next campaign. From there, you can organize creators into campaigns and track your outreach, all without leaving the conversation.

Upfluence inside ChatGPT makes creator discovery and campaign management faster, more intuitive, and easier to act on.
payload.longDescription:
无需在多个平台之间切换，即可发现合适的创作者并开展营销活动。只需用日常语言描述你的需求，ChatGPT 就会返回由 Upfluence 搜索引擎提供支持的结果。

例如：
“给我找一些讲英语、对可持续时尚感兴趣、拥有 50K–200K 粉丝的 TikTok 创作者。”
“这位创作者的受众人口统计特征是什么？”

根据你的需求，你会收到符合条件的精选创作者资料。查看关键信息、浏览他们的资料，并查看近期帖子，判断他们是否适合你的下一场营销活动。之后，你可以将创作者整理到营销活动中并跟踪外联进展，全程无需离开当前对话。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 Upfluence，可让创作者发现和营销活动管理变得更快捷、更直观，也更便于采取行动。

payload.name: AI Producer by OpusClip
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create an editable talking-head video in chat. Upload footage, direct cuts, captions, reframing, and motion graphics, then open the AI Producer preview to refine or export.
payload.longDescription: 在聊天中创建可编辑的人物出镜讲话视频。上传素材，指示剪辑、字幕、重新取景和动态图形操作，然后打开 AI Producer 预览，进一步完善或导出。

payload.name: Lians Memory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Lians Memory stores project facts and decisions that users explicitly choose to keep, recalls bounded context with evidence, and permanently forgets a selected memory only after confirmation. It does not increase OpenAI usage quotas or bypass rate limits.
payload.longDescription: Lians Memory 会保存用户明确选择保留的项目事实和决策，提供附有依据的有限上下文；只有在获得确认后，才会永久忘记选定的记忆。它不会增加 OpenAI 使用额度，也不会绕过速率限制。

payload.name: SourcePRD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SourcePRD reads your codebase and writes the product story: the doors people come in through, the areas inside, and every capability — what it is, how people use it, and the files that implement it. Not the plan; the product as it exists in the code today.

Connect it and ChatGPT can answer from that story: what the product does, how a capability works for the person using it, which files stand behind it, and what changed this day, week or month. Seven read-only tools cover your projects, the product overview, the full story, doors and areas and capabilities, one capability in depth with its implementing files, search, and recent change.

Sign in with your SourcePRD account and allow read access; every project you can open is available. Nothing is written back to your code or your account. Every account can read the public demo projects, so you can try it before connecting a repository.
payload.longDescription:
SourcePRD 会读取你的代码库并撰写产品说明：用户通过哪些入口进入、里面有哪些区域，以及每项功能是什么、用户如何使用它、由哪些文件实现。它描述的不是计划，而是代码中今天实际存在的产品。

连接后，ChatGPT 可以根据这份说明回答：产品能做什么、用户如何使用某项功能、哪些文件支撑该功能，以及今天、本周或本月发生了哪些变化。七个只读工具涵盖你的项目、产品概览、完整说明、入口/区域/功能、某项功能的详细信息及其实现文件、搜索和近期变更。

使用 SourcePRD 账户登录并允许读取权限；你能打开的每个项目都可访问。任何内容都不会写回你的代码或账户。每个账户都可以读取公开演示项目，因此连接代码库前即可先行体验。

payload.name: Pocket Informant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pocket Informant helps users retrieve projects, calendars, contexts, tags, tasks, events, and notes from their private account, then create new projects, calendars, contexts, tags, tasks, events, and notes.
payload.longDescription: Pocket Informant 帮助用户从私人账户中检索项目、日历、情境、标签、任务、活动和笔记，并创建新的项目、日历、情境、标签、任务、活动和笔记。

payload.name: Voarq
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Voarq helps architecture firms manage day-to-day operations directly in ChatGPT. Review projects, deadlines, tracked time, clients, Weekly Direction, and financial data. Create and update projects, clients, schedules, notes, expenses, proposals, timers, project stages, client access, notifications, and public app content. Voarq analyzes current office context before higher-impact changes and asks for confirmation when needed. Weekly Direction is read-only and cannot be deleted or regenerated through the plugin. Account settings, passwords, security, subscriptions, billing, and external money transfers are outside the plugin's scope.
payload.longDescription: Voarq 帮助建筑事务所直接在 ChatGPT 中管理日常运营。查看项目、截止日期、工时记录、客户、Weekly Direction 和财务数据。创建和更新项目、客户、日程、备注、支出、提案、计时器、项目阶段、客户访问权限、通知和公开应用内容。进行影响较大的更改前，Voarq 会分析当前事务所的上下文，并在需要时请求确认。Weekly Direction 为只读，无法通过此插件删除或重新生成。账户设置、密码、安全、订阅、账单和外部资金转账不属于插件功能范围。

payload.name: Vibe AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turn every conversation into organized, searchable memory. Vibe AI is the 1st contextual AI workspace — paired with Vibe Dot and Vibe Bot, it captures what's said and keeps your work moving.

Sync recordings from your Vibe devices, then review transcripts, summaries, action items, and notes you can revisit anytime.

Ask questions across past conversations, find key decisions, and keep your work context connected across meetings and memos.
payload.longDescription:
将每次对话转化为有条理、可搜索的记忆。Vibe AI 是第 1 个情境式 AI 工作区；配合 Vibe Dot 和 Vibe Bot 使用，可记录对话内容，推动工作持续进行。

同步来自 Vibe 设备的录音，然后查看转录、摘要、行动项目和笔记，随时都可以重新查阅。

跨过往对话提出问题、查找关键决策，并让会议和备忘录中的工作上下文保持连贯。

payload.name: Hardline
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hardline MCP connects your notes from your phone calls and site meetings to ChatGPT.

Use this MCP when you are looking to connect real time data from the jobsite into your tools and workflows.
- Writing the daily log: Pull the decisions, commitments, and delivery updates from today's calls straight into the log, instead of backfilling from memory hours later.
- Drafting an RFI or change order: Pull the field context behind it. What the architect approved, what the sub flagged, what changed on the call, all in the draft.
- Settling a "you told me to" dispute: Find who committed to what and when, with the exact call it came from. The contemporaneous record, on demand.
- Prepping an OAC or your three-week look-ahead: Combine what came up across the week's calls with your other project docs so nothing walks out the door.

How it works:
Your assistant can search your captured calls and site notes by project, person, trade, or timeframe, then cite the exact call in its answer. No more digging through your phone log to find "what the sub agreed to" or "when we approved that change."

The difference:
Instead of a messy notebook or storing all the important to-dos in your head, Hardline captures the phone calls you're already making, keeps the transcript (not the audio)  and turns them into structured records that you can use in all your workflows.
payload.longDescription:
Hardline MCP 将电话和现场会议笔记连接到 ChatGPT。

如果你希望把工地实时数据接入工具和工作流，可以使用此 MCP。
- 编写每日记录：直接从当天通话中提取决策、承诺和交付更新写入日志，无需几小时后再凭记忆补录。
- 起草 RFI（信息请求）或变更单：提取现场背景信息，将建筑师批准的事项、分包商提出的问题及通话中的变更写入草稿。
- 处理“你当时让我这么做”的争议：查明谁在何时作出了承诺，并定位对应的准确通话。需要时即可调取当时的记录。
- 准备 OAC（业主、建筑师、承包商会议）或三周前瞻计划：整合本周各次通话及其他项目文件中的信息，避免重要事项遗漏。

工作方式：
助手可以按项目、人员、工种或时间范围搜索已记录的通话和现场笔记，并在回答中引用准确通话。无需再翻找手机通话记录，查“分包商答应了什么”或“我们什么时候批准了那项变更”。

不同之处：
Hardline 会记录你本来就在进行的通话，仅保留转录文本（不保存音频），并将其整理成结构化记录，供各类工作流程使用，省去杂乱笔记或把所有待办都记在脑中的麻烦。

payload.name: Call Me
payload.description: 打电话向真人寻求答案
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Call Me lets AI agents ring a human's phone, speak a question aloud, and return the spoken answer as text. Agents can also send messages, receive replies, and keep each task organized as a conversation thread. A built-in demo line (number 5550001234) answers calls and texts automatically, so the full loop can be tried without installing the phone app.
payload.longDescription: Call Me 可让 AI 智能体拨打真人的电话，口头提出问题，并将对方的口头回答以文本形式返回。智能体也可以发送消息、接收回复，并将每项任务整理为一个对话线程。内置演示专线（号码 5550001234）会自动接听电话和短信，因此无需安装手机应用即可体验完整流程。

payload.name: Oi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Oi helps you discover, install, and use reusable AI agent contexts for real work. Browse public and private agent contexts, pick one that fits your task, and launch it in ChatGPT or Codex with clear instructions and setup. Teams can standardize how they use AI for design, engineering, research, support, and other workflows without rewriting prompts every time.
payload.longDescription: Oi 帮助你发现、安装并使用可重复利用的 AI 智能体上下文来完成实际工作。浏览公开和私有的智能体上下文，选择适合任务的内容，然后按照清晰的说明和设置步骤，在 ChatGPT 或 Codex 中启动。团队可以统一 AI 在设计、工程、研究、支持及其他工作流程中的使用方式，无需每次都重写提示词。

payload.name: PostSyncer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Schedule and publish social media posts from ChatGPT. PostSyncer connects ChatGPT to your Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest, Telegram and Mastodon accounts - 11 networks from one app.

Ask ChatGPT to write a caption, attach an image or video (including ones it just generated), and post now or schedule it across several networks at once, with per-platform variants. Ask how a post or an account performed and get views, likes, comments and shares back in the chat. Sync and reply to comments, hide spam, group posts into campaigns, and keep a media library - all without opening a dashboard.

Setup is one click: install the app and sign in to PostSyncer. Publishing goes through PostSyncer's official platform integrations, so ChatGPT never sees your social logins.

Try: "@PostSyncer schedule this video to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts for tomorrow at 9am" - "@PostSyncer draft a week of LinkedIn and X posts about our launch and schedule them" - "@PostSyncer which of my posts got the most views this month?"
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中安排并发布社交媒体帖子。PostSyncer 可将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Instagram、TikTok、YouTube、X（Twitter）、LinkedIn、Facebook、Threads、Bluesky、Pinterest、Telegram 和 Mastodon 账户，一个应用即可管理 11 个平台。

让 ChatGPT 撰写配文、附加图片或视频（包括刚刚生成的内容），然后立即发布，或一次性安排到多个平台，并为每个平台生成不同版本。询问帖子或账户的表现，即可在聊天中查看浏览量、点赞、评论和分享数据。同步并回复评论、隐藏垃圾内容、将帖子归入营销活动，还可管理媒体库，全程无需打开控制面板。

只需一步即可完成设置：安装应用并登录 PostSyncer。发布操作通过 PostSyncer 的官方平台集成完成，因此 ChatGPT 不会看到你的社交账户登录信息。

试试这样提问：“@PostSyncer 将这段视频安排到 TikTok、Instagram Reels 和 YouTube Shorts，明天上午 9 点发布”——“@PostSyncer 为我们的发布活动起草一周的 LinkedIn 和 X 帖子并安排发布”——“@PostSyncer 我这个月哪条帖子浏览量最高？”

payload.name: CI HUB
payload.description: 管理你的 DAM 资产
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CI HUB helps users search and browse connected DAMs, storage providers, images services. Inspect and download files and brand kits, upload and organize assets and folders.
payload.longDescription: CI HUB 帮助用户搜索和浏览已连接的 DAM、存储服务提供商及图像服务。查看并下载文件和品牌素材包，上传并整理资产与文件夹。

payload.name: Storydoc
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Storydoc turns your presentation templates into finished, personalized decks from a conversation. Browse the templates in your Storydoc account, fill their variables to create a new version for a specific client, or generate a brand-new deck from scratch with the AI wizard. Every deck lands in your Storydoc account and comes back as a shareable short URL. You can also ask how your decks are performing and get engagement totals, top stories and versions, and breakdowns by device and location.
payload.longDescription: Storydoc 可以通过对话将演示模板转化为完成度高、个性化的演示文稿。浏览 Storydoc 账户中的模板，为特定客户填写变量并创建新版本，也可以使用 AI 向导从头生成全新的演示文稿。每份演示文稿都会保存到你的 Storydoc 账户，并以可分享的短链接形式返回。你还可以询问演示文稿的表现，获取互动总量、热门故事和版本，以及按设备和地点划分的数据。

payload.name: Octen
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Octen gives ChatGPT live information from the web through Octen's hosted MCP server: real-time web search with query-relevant highlights and filters, a dedicated news vertical, broad multi-angle search for research and comparisons, clean URL-to-markdown extraction for reading and grounding answers, and (invite-only beta) image and video search. Users connect their Octen account via OAuth; no API key configuration is needed.
payload.longDescription: Octen 通过其托管 MCP 服务器为 ChatGPT 提供实时网络信息：包含查询相关重点和筛选器的实时网页搜索、专门的新闻频道、用于研究和比较的多角度广泛搜索、便于阅读和提供答案依据的网址转 Markdown 提取，以及（仅限受邀用户的 Beta 版）图片和视频搜索。用户通过 OAuth 连接 Octen 账户；无需配置 API 密钥。

payload.name: Native Soil
payload.description: 保存并加载 AI 对话状态
payload.summaryOriginal: Save and load AI chat state
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Native Soil saves the working state of your AI chat (the decisions, the context, and the plan) and lets you load it in any other model, client, or provider. Switch tools, hit a context limit, or come back tomorrow, and pick up where you left off instead of re-explaining everything. Every save is checked and graded before it is stored, secrets and private data are stripped, and nothing in your chat is changed or deleted. On shared projects, loads are measured with a recall check, so you can see what actually carried over and what needs review. Type "soil save" to capture the state, then "soil load" to restore it anywhere.
payload.longDescription: Native Soil 会保存 AI 对话的工作状态（决策、上下文和计划），并让你在任何其他模型、客户端或服务提供商中加载这些内容。切换工具、达到上下文限制，或明天再回来时，你可以从上次中断处继续，无需重新解释所有内容。每次保存都会经过检查和评分，保存前会剔除机密信息和私人数据；聊天内容不会被更改或删除。在共享项目中，加载结果会通过回忆检查进行衡量，让你了解实际恢复了哪些内容，以及哪些需要复核。输入 “soil save” 捕获状态，再输入 “soil load” 即可在任何地方恢复。

payload.name: Rox
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rox helps users find and analyze authenticated sales data from their Rox workspace, including accounts, deals, contacts, notes, emails, meetings, documents, org charts, and Slack activity. The app exposes a guided data interface: users can discover available data functions, inspect each function's schema and workflow guidance, then invoke read-only functions to answer sales and account intelligence questions.
payload.longDescription: Rox 帮助用户查找和分析其 Rox 工作区中经过身份验证的销售数据，包括客户账户、交易、联系人、备注、电子邮件、会议、文档、组织结构图和 Slack 活动。该应用提供引导式数据界面：用户可以发现可用的数据功能，查看各功能的 schema 和工作流指导，然后调用只读功能来回答销售和客户情报问题。

payload.name: Mallary
payload.description: 在社交媒体发布并回复
payload.summaryOriginal: Post and reply on social media
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Mallary in ChatGPT to publish and schedule posts, upload media, read and reply to comments, and check post and audience results across your connected social media accounts.
payload.longDescription: 在 ChatGPT 中使用 Mallary，在你已连接的社交媒体账户上发布和安排帖子、上传媒体、阅读并回复评论，以及查看帖子和受众数据。

payload.name: PlatoForms
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see. A team owner controls whether the team is reachable this way at all, from Account → API.

Requirements

A PlatoForms account on a plan that includes API access. Actions count against your plan's API allowance. Teams in HIPAA mode have this access switched off by default and must opt in explicitly; data sent to a third-party AI assistant is not covered by the PlatoForms Business Associate Agreement.

What the plugin cannot do

It cannot edit an existing form or document, publish, delete, rename or duplicate anything, send email, or configure workflows, integrations or notifications. Those stay in the PlatoForms editor.

payload.name: Planday
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect directly to your Planday account to manage scheduling, shifts, and team absences entirely through natural conversation.

Save time and streamline your daily operations by bringing instant workforce insights directly into your workflow. Instead of switching tabs, you can simply ask for what you need: check who is on shift next Saturday, see Anna’s remaining annual leave balance, or instantly verify James’s working-time compliance before booking his next shift. You can draft, assign, and publish shifts individually, or ask ChatGPT to factor in upcoming events to help you quickly coordinate next week's schedule.

Core Capabilities:

Scheduling: View, create, assign, and publish shifts by department, employee, or date.
Employees: Look up staff groups, roles, and department structures.
Absence: Check live leave balances and review policies
Compliance: Check working-time rules on a schedule

Enterprise-Grade Security & Permissions:
Every action respects your existing Planday user permissions. Managers only access manager-level data, while employees only see their own information. No data is surfaced that would not normally be available to you inside the Planday app.

Securely connect via your standard Planday login with zero configuration required.
payload.longDescription:
直接连接您的 Planday 账户，通过自然对话全面管理排班、班次和团队休假。

将即时劳动力信息直接带入工作流，节省时间并简化日常运营。无需切换标签页，只需询问所需信息：查看下周六谁在上班、查看 Anna 剩余的年假天数，或在安排 James 的下一班之前立即核实其工时合规情况。您可以逐个起草、分配和发布班次，也可以让 ChatGPT 考虑即将到来的活动，快速协调下周的日程。

核心功能：

排班：按部门、员工或日期查看、创建、分配和发布班次。
员工：查询员工组、职位和部门结构。
休假：查看实时假期余额并查阅相关政策。
合规：检查排班中的工时规则。

企业级安全与权限：
每项操作都遵循您现有的 Planday 用户权限。经理只能访问经理级别的数据，员工只能查看自己的信息。不会显示您在 Planday 应用中通常无权查看的任何数据。

使用您的标准 Planday 登录信息即可安全连接，无需任何配置。

payload.name: Aphex
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your AI tool to your construction delivery data in Aphex — ask questions and draft reports grounded in the live site record.
payload.longDescription: 将你的AI工具连接到Aphex中的建筑交付数据，提出问题，并根据施工现场的实时记录起草报告。

payload.name: Thriveworks Jobs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Thriveworks Jobs helps job seekers explore open roles at Thriveworks. Search by job title, location, or both — the assistant surfaces relevant opportunities and lets you dig into the details before applying. Powered by Appcast.
payload.longDescription: Thriveworks Jobs 帮助求职者探索 Thriveworks 的空缺职位。按职位名称、地点或两者搜索，助手会显示相关机会，并允许你在申请前深入了解详情。由 Appcast 提供支持。

payload.name: GoSearch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoSearch connects your AI assistant to your organization's knowledge base. Ask a question and get answers pulled from the apps your team already uses, like Google Drive, Slack, Jira, Notion, and 100+ more, all in one place.

  Use it two ways:
  - Search across your connected apps to find the document, message, or ticket you need, with links back to the source.
  - Ask GoAI a question and get a written answer grounded in your organization's content, with citations so you can verify where it came from.

  GoSearch respects your existing permissions, so you only see results from content you already have access to.
payload.longDescription:
GoSearch 将 AI 助手连接到组织的知识库。提出问题，即可从团队已在使用的应用中获取答案，例如 Google Drive、Slack、Jira、Notion 等 100 多种工具，所有内容汇集一处。

有两种使用方式：
- 搜索已连接的应用，找到所需的文档、消息或工单，并附上返回来源的链接。
- 向 GoAI 提问，获得基于组织内容撰写的答案，并附有引用，供你核实信息出处。

GoSearch 遵循你现有的权限，因此你只能看到自己已经有权访问的内容。

payload.name: Memocore
payload.description: 持久共享 AI 记忆
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Memocore gives ChatGPT persistent memory that carries across every conversation. Save facts, preferences, projects, and notes once — private to you or shared with a team — and Memocore recalls them automatically whenever they're relevant, so you never repeat context again.
payload.longDescription: Memocore 为 ChatGPT 提供可延续到每次对话中的持久记忆。只需保存一次事实、偏好、项目和笔记（仅供自己使用或与团队共享），Memocore 就会在相关时自动回忆它们，让你不必再重复提供上下文。
